summary: Validate numerical models through dimensional checks, invariants, limiting cases, convergence, stability, and independent references with explicit uncertainty boundaries.
triggers: A simulation needs units, conservation, limiting-case, or convergence checks.
Solver stability or model-form uncertainty must be separated from measurement evidence.
A numerical result needs an honest boundary before interpretation or design use.
antiTriggers: Claim hardware performance from simulation alone.
Run a model with undefined units, boundary conditions, or tolerances.
Tune away failed convergence or conservation without recording it.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Units, invariants, limits, convergence, stability, uncertainty, and proof-boundary semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no physical or numerical qualification is asserted.
